entries.guide_zh: 作者分享微调 Llama 2 的尝试，探索用自己的开源模型替代 GPT-3.5 或 GPT-4。

entries.title: Show HN: HyperDX – open-source dev-friendly Datadog alternative
entries.author: mikeshi42
entries.current_title: Show HN: HyperDX – open-source dev-friendly Datadog alternative
entries.excerpt: Hi HN, Mike and Warren here! We've been building HyperDX (hyperdx.io). HyperDX allows you to easily search and correlate logs, traces, metrics (alpha), and session replays all in one place. For example, if a user reports a bug “this button doesn't work," an engineer can play back what the user was doing in their browser and trace API calls back to the backend logs for that specific request, all from a single view. Github Repo: https://github.com/hyperdxio/hyperdx Coming from
entries.guide_zh: HyperDX 将日志、追踪、指标与会话回放集中起来，帮助开发者排查问题。

entries.title: Show HN: ElectricSQL, Postgres to SQLite active-active sync for local-first apps
entries.author: samwillis
entries.current_title: Show HN: ElectricSQL, Postgres to SQLite active-active sync for local-first apps
entries.excerpt: Hi HN, James, Valter, Sam and the team from ElectricSQL here. We're really excited to be sharing ElectricSQL with you today. It's an open source, local-first sync layer that can be used to build reactive, realtime, offline-capable apps directly on Postgres with two way active-active sync to SQLite (including with WASM in the browser). entries.guide_zh: ElectricSQL 在 PostgreSQL 与 SQLite 间双向同步，支持本地优先与离线应用。
